name: KSHSAA State Cross Country Championships
where: Lawrence, KS · Rim Rock Farm (3A, 5A, 6A) · Wamego Country Club (1A, 2A, 4A)
headline: KSHSAA State Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: Kapaun Mount Carmel's Ava Claasen won the 5A girls race in 16:59.16 as St. Thomas Aquinas took the team title (69). In 6A, Blue Valley Northwest's D'Souza won the boys race in 15:27.56 and Olathe West won the team title (83), while Manhattan won the girls team title (66) and Shawnee Mission East's Hardy won the race in 17:55.36. Blue Valley Southwest won the 5A boys title (53) behind winner Claar (15:45.01), and Wichita Trinity Academy won the 3A boys title (41).
